title: Amazing, could use more work
body: I think the app is very good, I purchased it long time ago and i’m using it for my habits. I do think you should add more things to it, it hasn’t changed for some time, like new ways to track things and displey. Also, where are widgets, still nothing? They don’t seem to appear anywhere but i saw you should have them… Please, add more ways to track the data like different graphs and similar.
author: Mikilx
